app.name: MusicClub
app.tagline: Meet people who share your taste in music

login.title: Sign in
login.registered: Account created. You can sign in now.
login.verified: Address confirmed. Sign in to get started.
login.passwordReset: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.

register.title: Create an account
register.acceptTerms: I accept the <0>terms</0> and confirm that I have read the <1>privacy policy</1>. I am at least 16 years old.

users.title: Users
users.selfRoleHint: You cannot change your own role
users.banSet: The posting ban has been applied.
users.banLifted: The posting ban has been lifted.
users.selfDeleteHint: You cannot delete your own account
users.deleteQuestion: Really delete the account "{{username}}"? This cannot be undone.
users.deleteWhatGoes: All of their posts, photos, reactions and friendships go with it.
users.relatedHint: Accounts from the same address, and address blocking
users.relatedWarning: A shared address is a LEAD, not proof. One address can be a whole family, a dorm, or thousands of a mobile carrier's customers. Blocking an address stops sign-ups and logins for everyone using it.
users.noAddresses: This account has not logged in since address logging was switched on.
users.noRelated: No other account has logged in from these addresses.
users.blockReasonPrompt: Why are you blocking {{address}}? (the reason is stored)
users.blockedHint: These addresses cannot sign up or log in. Open sessions keep working — the block applies from the next login.

account.switchTitle: A different account was signed in on this computer
account.switchText: This tab was open as "{{previous}}", but meanwhile another tab signed in as "{{current}}". The page was reloaded so the two accounts' data do not get mixed.
account.switchHint: A browser remembers only one signed-in account at a time. To use two accounts at once (to test a conversation, for example), open the second one in a private window or in a different browser.

errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check whether the backend is running.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

settings.title: Account settings
settings.profileSaved: Your account details have been saved.
settings.dangerIntro: Neither of these can be undone. That is why we ask for your password, not just a click.
settings.deletePostsText: All your posts disappear along with their images and reactions. Your account stays.
settings.deleteAccountText: Posts, messages, friendships, favourites and playlists all disappear. This cannot be recovered.
settings.passwordHint: The same password you sign in with.
settings.languageHint: Also applies to messages sent by the server.
settings.themeHint: Light or dark — the choice is remembered in this browser.
settings.pendingEmailHint: We've sent a link there. Until you click it, your current address ({{email}}) stays in use.
settings.emailPasswordHint: Changing the address needs your password — the address is how you recover the account.
settings.sessionsHint: Signed in on someone else's computer or lost your phone? Sign out every device except this one.
settings.sessionsRevoked: Done — other devices were signed out.

avatar.title: Profile picture
avatar.saved: Your profile picture has been saved.
avatar.removed: Your profile picture has been removed.
avatar.hint: JPG, PNG, WEBP or GIF, at most 5 MB. After choosing you can crop and rotate it.
avatar.preview: Preview of the new profile picture
avatar.previewHint: This is how your avatar will look. Save it or adjust the crop.

posts.title: Feed
posts.contentPlaceholder: Write something about the music you are listening to…
posts.imagesHint: You can add images in batches — at most {{max}}, each up to 5 MB. The button in the thumbnail corner crops and rotates the image.
posts.tooLargeHint: {{count}} photo is over {{limit}}. Tap it to shrink it — or leave it and we will shrink it when posting.
posts.tooLargeHint_other: {{count}} photos are over {{limit}}. Tap them to shrink them — or leave them and we will shrink them when posting.
posts.compressImpossible: A GIF cannot shrink without losing its animation
posts.imagesNotEditable: Images cannot be changed after publishing. To replace them, delete the post and add it again.
posts.musicPlaceholder: Paste a Spotify, YouTube Music or Apple Music link

musicHints.TRACK: A track link - Spotify, YouTube Music or Apple Music
musicHints.ALBUM: An album link from Spotify or Apple Music (in YouTube Music an album is a playlist)
musicHints.ARTIST: An artist link from Spotify or Apple Music
musicHints.PLAYLIST: A playlist link - Spotify, YouTube Music or Apple Music. Playlists do not count towards statistics.

posts.musicClearHint: Clear the field to remove the music from this post.

musicErrors.invalid: This is not a Spotify, YouTube Music or Apple Music link
musicErrors.youtubeNotMusic: That is a plain YouTube link. Open the recording in YouTube Music (music.youtube.com) and copy the address from there.

mismatch.TRACK: This is a TRACK link - switch the kind to "Track"
mismatch.ALBUM: This is an ALBUM link - switch the kind to "Album"
mismatch.ARTIST: This is an ARTIST link - switch the kind to "Artist"
mismatch.PLAYLIST: This is a PLAYLIST link - switch the kind to "Playlist"

visibility.label: Who can see this
visibility.PUBLICHint: Everyone can see it, including people you have not met yet. That is how you meet them.
visibility.FRIENDSHint: Only your friends can see it - the ones you have now and the ones you add later.

scope.label: What to show in the feed

posts.strangersBelow: Below: people you have not met yet

emptyAll.title: Nobody has posted anything yet
emptyAll.text: The feed shows your friends' posts first and public posts from everyone else below them. There are none of either yet, so the first post is yours.

emptyFriends.title: Your friends have not posted anything yet
emptyFriends.text: You narrowed the feed down to friends. You can widen it to the whole community or look for people with a similar taste.

order.label: Order of posts from people who are not your friends
order.RELEVANTHint: Posts from your area, from people with a similar taste and ones with a lot going on come first; older ones sink

favorites.title: Favourites
favorites.whyItMatters: Friend matching is based on this list - the more you add, the better the suggestions.
favorites.noArtists: This person has not added any favourite artists yet
favorites.noArtistsSelf: You have no favourite artists yet. Search for someone below.
favorites.noTracks: This person has not added any favourite tracks yet
favorites.noTracksSelf: You have no favourite tracks yet. Search for something below.
favorites.limitReached: Limit reached - remove something to make room.
favorites.lastFmHint: Enter your Last.fm username - we will fetch your most played artists and tracks. No password, no sign-in.
favorites.importSkipped: Skipped {{count}} entries that are not in the catalogue.
favorites.importAlready: {{count}} entries were already on the list.
favorites.importDisabled: Last.fm import is currently switched off.
favorites.importDisabledAdmin: To enable it, set the LASTFM_API_KEY variable (get a key at last.fm/api/account/create) and restart the app.

profile.noPosts: This user has not written any posts yet.
profile.noPostsSelf: You have no posts yet. Write your first one on the feed!
profile.noPostsHint: When {{username}} posts something, it will show up here and in your feed.
profile.noPostsSelfHint: Share a track, an album or a playlist and say why that one. This is where conversations start.

friends.title: Friends
friends.inviteHint: Enter the exact username. If that person invited you earlier, you become friends right away.
friends.noOutgoing: You have not sent any invitations.
friends.noSuggestions: There are no other users yet.
friends.betterMatchesHint: Nobody matches you yet. Add the artists and tracks you like to your profile - then the suggestions will stop being random.
friends.noneSelfHint: Add favourite artists and tracks to your profile - then the suggestions stop being random and you will find someone who listens to what you do.
friends.notAcceptingInvites: This person isn't accepting invitations right now

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.empty: Nothing new. When someone reacts to your post or sends you a friend request, it shows up here.
notifications.clanKicked: You are no longer in the clan {{name}}
notifications.clanRequestAccepted: Your request was accepted — you are now in the clan {{name}}
notifications.discoverMatch: A mutual “yes” with {{username}} — you're friends now

playlists.title: Playlist showcase
playlists.whatItIs: Up to five mixes you want someone to hear. This does not affect friend matching - that is what the favourite artists above are for.
playlists.emptySelf: Nothing here yet. Paste a playlist link from Spotify, YouTube Music or Apple Music.
playlists.addHint: Playlist link - Spotify, YouTube Music or Apple Music
playlists.full: The showcase is full. Remove one item to make room.

common_ground.title: What you have in common
common_ground.withPerson: What you have in common with {{username}}
common_ground.why: These are the actual things you share - easier to start a conversation with than "hi".
common_ground.nothingHint: Add favourite artists and tracks to your profile - then there will be something to compare.

chat.title: Messages
chat.emptyThread: This is the start of your conversation with {{username}}. Send the first message or share a track.
chat.noFriendsHint: Messages go to friends. Find someone with a similar taste and send an invitation — the conversation will follow.
chat.listFailed: Could not load the conversation list
chat.friendsOnly: Messages go to friends only. This person is no longer your friend - you can read the conversation, but you cannot write in it.
chat.deleteConversationText: It disappears only for you. {{username}} keeps their copy.

contextHints.PROFILE: The administrator will look at the profile — the name, picture and what this person shows about themselves.
contextHints.POST: We will attach the content of that post to the report.
contextHints.CONVERSATION: We will attach a copy of the last 20 messages from your conversation. Only an administrator will see them.
contextHints.CLAN: The administrator will look at the clan’s name, tag, description and images. We attach a copy of the name and description as they are now.
contextHints.COMMENT: We will attach the text of this comment to the report. The administrator will see it together with the post it is under.

reports.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the problem in your own words…
reports.descriptionHint: Write at least one sentence — a reason picked from a list does not tell the administrator what to look for.
reports.sent: The report reached an administrator. Thank you — they will review it and decide what to do.
reports.evidenceHint: A copy of the conversation from the moment of reporting — kept even if the messages have since been deleted.
reports.noEvidence: No attached evidence — the profile itself is the evidence.
reports.noteHint: Closing a report does NOTHING to the account by itself. You apply penalties in the users panel.
reports.emptyOpenHint: All reports are closed. New ones will show up here and on the bell.
reports.deleteAccountWarning: Deleting an account cannot be undone - all of their posts, photos, reactions and friendships go with it.
reports.confirmDeleteAccount: Really delete the account "{{username}}"? This cannot be undone.

actions.NONE: do nothing - just record the decision
actions.CLEAR_CARD: clear the profile card (photos, bio, questions) and turn off Discover

reports.reopenHint: Reopens the case. It does not undo actions that were already carried out.
reports.selfReportHint: This report is about your own account - you can close it, but you cannot punish yourself.
reports.evidenceHintClan: The clan’s name and description at the time of the report — kept even if the clan is later changed or disbanded.
reports.openComment: Open the comment under the post

myReports.title: My reports
myReports.intro: Reports you have sent and how they ended. An administrator always leaves a note when closing a case.
myReports.empty: You have not sent any reports yet
myReports.emptyHint: You can report someone from their profile or from a post.
myReports.openHint: An administrator has not looked at it yet.
myReports.noPunishmentInfo: We do not show what penalty the reported person received - that is their business.

events.title: Events
events.subtitle: Concerts and music nights
events.importingText: The first download for a new country usually takes a few seconds. The list will refresh by itself.
events.countryEmptyText: Ticketmaster has no concerts in this country right now, or the download hasn't succeeded yet. Pick another country or check back later.
events.emptyText: Pick another city or try a different search.
events.waitingText: The first download takes about a minute after the server starts. Check back shortly.
events.notConfiguredText: This tab will work once an administrator sets it up.
events.notConfiguredAdmin: The server has no Ticketmaster key. Add TICKETMASTER_API_KEY to the .env file and restart the backend.
events.past: This event has already taken place.
events.postponedInfo: This event has been postponed. No new date yet.
events.rescheduledInfo: This event has a new date — shown below.
events.notFound: No such event. It may have been withdrawn from sale.
events.forYouHint: Artists you listen to come first, then artists behind your tracks, shared genres and what your friends are going to.
events.forYouLastFmHint: Genres are compared only broadly for now — they will get sharper once LASTFM_API_KEY is set.
events.noTasteTitle: We don't know what you listen to yet
events.noTasteText: Add favourite artists and tracks on your profile — then we will show concerts that match them here.
events.noMatchText: Nothing here matches your favourites. Pick another city or look through all upcoming events.
events.mineEmptyText: Tap “Interested” or “Going” on an event page — the event will show up here.
events.hideMe: Don't show me on the attendee list
events.hideMeHint: You still count towards the total, just without your name.
events.attendeesNone: Nobody has said they're going yet.
events.attendeesHidden: and {{count}} person who prefers not to be listed
events.attendeesHidden_other: and {{count}} people who prefer not to be listed
events.withdrawnInfo: This event is no longer on Ticketmaster — it may have been cancelled or moved. Check with the organiser.

posts.title: Posts
posts.label: Write about this event
posts.placeholder: Looking for company? Say where you're coming from or where to meet before the show…
posts.emptyText: Looking for people to go with? Write a post — everyone who opens this event will see it, and it shows up in the feed too.

events.forYouNearHint: Concerts from your area come first.
events.nearEmptyText: Try a larger range or show concerts from the whole country.
events.nearEmptyForYou: Nothing in your area matches your taste. Increase the range or show the whole country.

verify.sentTo: We've sent a confirmation link to
verify.checkText: Click it to finish creating your account. The link works for 24 hours. Can't see the email? Look in your Spam or Promotions folder.
verify.resent: We've sent a new link to {{email}}.
verify.wrongAddress: Typo in the address? Fix it
verify.afterClick: Once you click the link, you can sign in.
verify.noToken: The page address is missing the code from the email. Open the link again using the button in the email.
verify.failedHint: You can ask for a new link when signing in.
verify.doneText: All set — your account is active. Confirmed address:
verify.changedText: From now on your account uses:
verify.waitingOldText: One more step: approve the change with the link we sent to your current address. Until then the account keeps the old address. New address:

reset.title: Forgot your password?
reset.intro: Enter your account's email address — we'll send a link to set a new password.
reset.noMail: This server doesn't send email, so it can't send the link. Contact the administrator.
reset.sentText: If an account with this address exists, we've sent a link to it:
reset.sentHint: The link works for an hour. Can't see the email? Check your Spam folder.
reset.logoutEverywhere: Changing the password signs out every device — including those with "Remember me".
reset.doneText: Every device was signed out. Sign in with your new password.

approve.title: Email address change
approve.question: The account {{username}} wants to change its email to:
approve.noHint: "It wasn't me" cancels the change and signs out every device. Then set a new password.
approve.waitingText: The change takes effect once the new address is confirmed too — the link went to:
approve.deniedText: The account address didn't change and every device was signed out. Someone may know your password — set a new one.

block.effectFriends: Your friendship is removed and invitations are cancelled.
block.effectContent: You won't see each other's posts or profiles.
block.effectInvite: You won't be able to invite or message each other — the chat history stays.
block.effectUndo: You can unblock any time in Settings. The friendship won't come back by itself.
block.blockedText: You don't see {{username}}'s posts, and they don't see yours.
block.listHint: You can block someone from their profile.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.profileVisibility: Who can see my profile details
privacy.profileVisibilityHint: Favourites, friends, playlists and posts on the profile. Public posts still show in the feed — you set visibility on each post.
privacy.friendRequestsFrom: Who can send me friend requests
privacy.hideOnAttendeeLists: Hide me on event attendee lists by default
privacy.restrictedText: Only {{username}}'s friends can see their profile details.
privacy.clanInvitesFrom: Who can invite me to a clan
privacy.clanInvitesHint: You join a clan by invitation or by a request the clan accepts — this setting is about invitations. You can accept or decline; whoever got a refusal can't invite you again for a week.
privacy.showCity: Show my city on my profile and in friend suggestions

push.title: Notifications
push.remindersHint: 3 days and 1 day before an event you're going to or interested in — in the bell, and on your phone if you turn it on below.
push.serverOff: Phone notifications aren't enabled on this server. Reminders will show up in the bell.
push.unsupported: This browser doesn't support push notifications. On iPhone they work after adding MusicClub to the Home Screen (Share → Add to Home Screen).
push.blocked: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings. Allow them for this site (the lock icon next to the address) and come back here.
push.offHint: Event reminders, invitations (to friends and to a clan) and new messages in your clan chat as phone notifications — even when the app is closed. You can mute the clan chat on its page.
push.permissionRefused: The browser didn't get permission to show notifications.
push.disabled: Notifications are off on this device.
push.testSent: Sent — the notification should appear in a moment.

clans.title: Clan
clans.leaveConfirm: Leave the clan {{name}}? You can only come back with a new invitation. Your posts and messages stay in the clan.
clans.adminBanner: You are viewing this clan as an app administrator. This is done only after a report or when a violation of the rules or the law is suspected; every visit is written to the log.
clans.inviteOnly: You can join this clan only by invitation from one of its members.
clans.moderationNotice: The app administrator can view clan content — only after a report or when a violation of the rules or the law is suspected.

none.title: You're not in a clan
none.text: You join a clan by invitation from a member, or by sending a request to a clan that accepts them (find one in the clan browser). You can also start your own.

create.title: Start a clan
create.hint: A clan has its own chat and posts that nobody outside it can see. Its members pick the colour by voting. You join by invitation or — if the clan allows it — by a request the leaders accept.
create.name: Clan name
create.iconHint: A small image next to the tag — shown next to every member's username. After choosing, you can crop it to a square and rotate it.
create.iconFailed: The clan was created, but the icon couldn't be uploaded: {{reason}} You can add it in the clan settings.
create.preview: This is how it will look next to a username:
create.more: More: motto, city, genres, how people join

members.title: Members
members.inviteHint: You can invite someone who isn't in any clan and allows invitations in their privacy settings. They can accept or decline.
members.transferConfirm: Hand the clan over to {{username}}? You will become a clan admin.
members.kickConfirm: Remove {{username}} from the clan? They will get a notification that doesn't say who did it.

color.title: Clan colour
color.hint: Members choose the colour: everyone has one vote and the colour with the most votes wins (on a tie, the one voted for earlier). Votes are public.

chat.title: Clan chat
chat.empty: Nobody has written anything yet. Start the conversation!
chat.readOnly: You are reading as an app administrator — you can't write here.
chat.mutedNote: Phone notifications from this chat are muted — the unread counter still works.

posts.title: Clan posts
posts.placeholder: Write something for the clan — only its members will see it…
posts.emptyTitle: The clan has no posts yet
posts.emptyText: Only members can see clan posts. They don't show up in the feed or on profiles.

settings.icon: Icon (small image next to the tag)
settings.imagesHint: The icon and photo are visible to everyone — they show on the badge and on the clan page. Before uploading, you can crop and rotate the image.
settings.disbandHint: Disbanding removes the clan together with its chat, posts and invitations. This can't be undone.
settings.disbandConfirm: Disband the clan {{name}}? It will disappear together with its chat and posts — permanently.
settings.announcementHint: Shown at the top of the clan page, above the chat. Leave empty to take it down.
settings.rulesHint: Keep it short — invited people see it before joining, members see it on the clan page.

taste.title: Clan taste
taste.intro: Artists and genres liked by at least two people in the clan. Without saying who.
taste.none: Nothing in common yet. Once at least two people add the same artists to their favourites, they will show up here.
taste.counted: Counted {{counted}} of {{members}}. Profiles limited to friends are left out.

weekly.title: Track of the week
weekly.hint: Drop a link to a track and the rest of the clan votes. The week runs from Monday to Sunday.
weekly.noneLeft: You have used this week’s suggestion limit.
weekly.urlHint: Spotify, YouTube Music or Apple Music
weekly.empty: Nobody has suggested anything this week yet.
weekly.deleteConfirm: Delete this suggestion together with its votes?

events.title: Clan at concerts
events.intro: Upcoming events that clan members signed up for. You sign up in the Events tab.
events.emptyTitle: Nobody from the clan has signed up for a concert yet
events.emptyText: When someone marks “I’m going” or “Interested” on an event, it will show up here along with the rest of the clan.
events.hiddenNote: Some people prefer not to be listed — they are only in the counter.
events.askText: Who’s going to “{{name}}” ({{date}})? Let us know — maybe we can meet up!
events.askSent: The question is in the clan posts.

requests.title: Requests to join
requests.hint: Accepting lets the person in right away. Declining sends no notification or reason — they only see that the request wasn't accepted, and can try again after a week.

join.title: Joining
join.invited: You have an invitation to this clan.
join.pending: Your request is waiting for the clan leaders to answer.
join.declined: The leaders didn't accept your request. You can try again a week after the refusal.
join.hint: The clan leaders will see your request together with your username. You may add a few words about yourself — you don't have to.
join.messagePlaceholder: E.g. how we know each other, or what you listen to
join.unavailable: You can't ask to join this clan right now — for example because you're already in another clan.

about.title: About the clan
about.hidden: This clan doesn't show its taste to people outside it.
about.private: Only members see the chat, posts, polls and ranking.

activity.hint: Chat activity over the last 7 days — no message content

card.title: Profile card and joining
card.intro: What the clan says about itself in the clan browser. The chat, posts and polls stay private.
card.mottoPlaceholder: E.g. we play loud, we listen close
card.genresHint: Up to three genres that describe the clan best. The browser shows them next to the genres its members have in common.

policy.REQUESTS: People can ask to join (the leaders decide)

card.joinPolicyHint: Invitations from members always work. Requests are accepted or declined by the clan leaders.
card.listed: Show the clan in the clan browser
card.listedHint: A hidden clan isn't on the list, and only members and invited people see its taste and activity.

directory.title: Clan browser
directory.intro: Find a clan for you: search by name, filter by genre and city, sort by size, activity or match with your taste. You see only what the clan says about itself and aggregate taste — never the chat or posts.
directory.emptyTitle: No clans in the browser yet
directory.emptyText: Start the first one — others will find it here.
directory.emptyFilteredText: Change the filters or clear the search.
directory.tasteGenre: Genre shared by the clan's members
directory.matchArtists: Members listen to artists you like too
directory.withoutLocation_one: {{count}} clan was left out because we do not know where it is (no city).
directory.withoutLocation_other: {{count}} clans were left out because we do not know where they are (no city).
directory.nearEmptyText: Try a larger range or show clans from the whole country.

titles.title: Titles in the clan
titles.intro: A title is a decoration next to a username inside the clan — it doesn't change permissions. The leaders can give it, leave it to be taken by anyone, or award it automatically for activity.
titles.none: The clan has no titles yet.
titles.noneManager: The clan has no titles yet. Add the first one below — you can start from a ready-made template.
titles.deleteConfirm: Delete the title “{{name}}”? It will disappear for everyone who has it.
titles.presetsHint: Ready-made templates fill in the form — you can still change them.
titles.name: Title name
titles.autoHint: Everything since joining the clan counts. When you change the threshold, titles are recalculated on their own.

polls.none: No polls yet. Start the first one — e.g. “Which concert are we going to?”.
polls.voteHint: click your answer again to withdraw your vote
polls.deleteConfirm: Delete this poll together with its votes?
polls.question: Question
polls.questionPlaceholder: E.g. which concert are we going to together?

ranking.breakdown: Of which: messages {{messages}}, posts {{posts}}, tracks {{tracks}}, votes {{votes}}, reactions {{reactions}}.
ranking.title: Activity ranking
ranking.empty: Nobody has done anything in this period yet — write the first message!
ranking.how: A chat message is 1 point, a post 4, a suggested track 3, a vote (for the track of the week or in a poll) 1, a reaction under a message 1. The level depends on all-time points, so it never drops. The weekly goal is a shared score of the whole clan over the last 7 days.

legal.missing: [to be filled in by the site owner]
legal.unfilled: The site owner hasn't filled in the controller details yet (LEGAL_CONTROLLER, LEGAL_CONTACT_EMAIL) — places in square brackets must be completed before the public launch.

notice.title: Terms and privacy policy
notice.new: We have terms of service and a privacy policy.
notice.updated: We have updated the terms of service and the privacy policy.

export.title: Your data
export.text: Download a ZIP with everything we keep about you: account data and settings, profile and favourites, posts (clan ones too) with photos, reactions, messages, friends, blocks, event sign-ups, notifications, clan and reports. The data is in JSON, which you can move to another service.
export.done: Done — the archive has been downloaded.
export.hint: We ask for your password because the archive holds sensitive data. You can download it at most once a minute. Messages contain the words of both sides of a conversation; there is no password or other people's data in it, apart from usernames.

location.title: My city
location.intro: Tell us your city and we will put people, concerts, clans and posts from your area first, not from the other end of the country. We store the city only — no exact address and no location from your phone.
location.hint: Pick a city from the suggestions and we will work out distances. You can type a city that is not on the list too — then only things in exactly the same city will match. Whether your city is shown on your profile is set below in Privacy.
location.saved: Saved. People, concerts and clans from your area now come first.
location.savedUnknown: Saved. We do not have this city on our list, so only things in the same city will match, without distances.
location.removed: City removed. Everything goes back to the order from before you set a city.
location.unknownCity: We do not have this city on our list, so we cannot work out distances — only people, clans and concerts in exactly the same city will match.
location.eventsNudge: Set your city and concerts from your area will come first.
location.clansNudge: Set your city and clans from your area will come first.
location.friendsNudge: Set your city and people from your area will come first in the suggestions.

comments.title: Comments
comments.hint: Type @ to mention someone. Ctrl+Enter sends.
comments.confirmDelete: Delete this comment? Replies under it disappear with it.
comments.empty: No comments yet — write the first one.

gifs.title: GIF browser
gifs.gone: This GIF is no longer available

card.title: Your card
card.subtitle: Photos, a few words about you and music questions. They show on your profile and — if you turn it on — in Discover.
card.photosHint: Up to {{max}} photos (JPG, PNG or WebP). The first one is the card cover — reorder with the arrows or by dragging. Before adding, you can crop each one (cards are 3:4) and rotate it. We remove camera data from photos, including where they were taken (GPS).
card.bioPlaceholder: E.g. I play bass, listen to shoegaze and I'm looking for a festival crew.
card.promptsHint: Answer at most {{max}} — the best way to start a conversation.

prompt.LIFE_CHANGING_ALBUM: The album that changed my life
prompt.PARTY_STARTER: At a party I put on
prompt.MORNING_SONG: A song for a good morning

card.emptyOwn: Fill in your card — photos, a few words about you and music questions

discover.nothingToUndo: Nothing to undo — a decision can be undone within 10 minutes.
discover.keyboardHint: Swipe the card or use the keys: ← not now · → yes
discover.limitReached: That's enough for today — more cards tomorrow.
discover.cityNudge: Set your city in your profile and the deck will start with people nearby.

empty.title: That's everyone for now
empty.textAll: No new cards. Check back later — the deck refreshes when someone new turns on Discover.

match.title: New friend!
match.text: You and {{username}} — a mutual “yes”. You're friends now.

start.title: Meet people who listen to what you do
start.lead: Cards of people nearby, one after another — from the most similar taste to the least.
start.stepRight: Swipe right if you'd like to meet someone.
start.stepLeft: Left — not now. That person will come back after a while.
start.stepMatch: You become friends only when both of you swipe right. Your “yes” stays secret until then.
start.privacy: Only people who also turned on Discover see your card: photos, bio, questions, city (if you show it) and the favourite artists you share.
start.todoBio: Write a few words about yourself
start.todoFavorites: Add favourite artists — that's what matching is based on
start.noCity: Without a city in your profile the deck covers the whole country.
start.rangeHint: You'll see the people with the most similar taste within this range first. You can change it any time.
start.canTurnOff: You can turn it off in Settings — your card then leaves the deck.

settings.title: Discover
settings.toggleHint: Only people who also turned this on see your card. A friendship forms only after a mutual “yes”.

imageEditor.title: Edit image
imageEditor.hint: Drag the crop area or its handles. Keyboard: arrows move it, Shift + arrows resize it.

fixed.awatar: Avatars are round — what's inside the circle is what people see.

imageEditor.loadFailed: This file can't be opened in the editor — the browser doesn't know its format or the file is damaged. You can still try adding it without editing.
imageEditor.animated: This is an animated GIF. Cropping or rotating leaves a single still frame. To keep the animation, click “Done” without changes.
imageEditor.saveFailed: Couldn't save the changes (e.g. not enough memory). Try again or use the image without editing.
imageEditor.notImage: That's not an image — choose a photo or a picture.
